parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotency of the request.

parameters.name: LoopMode
parameters.description:
The loop mode. Valid values:

- Automatic (default): The execution is not paused.

- FirstBatchPause: The execution is paused after the first batch of tasks is completed.

- EveryBatchPause: The execution is paused after each batch of tasks is completed.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The execution mode. Valid values:

- Automatic (default): The execution is automatically run.

- FailurePause: The execution is paused if a task fails.

- Debug: The execution is run in single-step mode.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The JSON string that consists of a collection of parameters. The default value is {}.

parameters.name: ParentExecutionId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent execution.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SafetyCheck
parameters.description:
The security check mode. Valid values:

- Skip (default): This option indicates that you are aware of the risks. The system performs all actions without asking for confirmation, regardless of the risk level. This mode is valid only when Mode is set to `Automatic`.

- **ConfirmEveryHighRiskAction**: This option requires you to confirm every high-risk action. You can call the NotifyExecution operation to confirm or cancel an action.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags to add to the execution.

parameters.name: TemplateContent
parameters.description: The content of the template, which must be in the JSON or YAML format. This parameter is the same as the Content request parameter of the CreateTemplate operation. You can specify this parameter to run the tasks in the template content without the need to create a template. You do not need to specify this parameter if you use an existing template to create an execution.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the template. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name can be up to 200 characters in length.

parameters.name: TemplateURL
parameters.description: The URL of the Object Storage Service (OSS) object that stores the OOS template content. The URL must be a public-read URL. You can specify this parameter to run the tasks in the template content that is stored in the OSS object without the need to create a template. You do not need to specify this parameter if you use an existing template to create an execution.

parameters.name: TemplateVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the template. If you do not specify this parameter, the latest version is used.
